calculation.description: Ranks assets higher when their trailing two-session return is negative, scaled by trailing 20-session daily volatility. Uses only completed prices available at the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive in 2020-2022 (0.046505; 760 observations), 2023-2024 (0.026465; 516 observations), and 2025-2026 (0.040998; 514 observations). Predictive power decays materially by ten sessions.
validation.universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; observations require at least 8 valid instruments
